content.value: Four masses A, B, C and D are attached to a shaft and revolve at equal Radii and are equally spaced along a shaft. The mass B is 7 Kg and the radii of C and D make angles of $9 \hat { 0 } ^ { 0 }$ and $2 4 0 ^ { 0 }$ respectively with the radius of B. find the magnitude of the masses A, C and D and the angular position of A so that thesystem may be completely balanced.
